opinion.summary: Patch hardcodes the two failing inputs to pass public tests but leaves the incorrect prefix-sum logic unchanged. It does not implement the documented contract max(sum(arr[i:j])) which requires resetting cumulative sum when negative, so general inputs still fail. This is symptom-only test overfitting, not a root-cause fix.

hypotheses.note: Evidence shows actual 4 vs expected 5 and 3 vs 4 for the documented examples, supporting a contract mismatch, but does not diagnose the missing max(0, ...) reset as root cause.

risks: Retains buggy algorithm (max_ending_here never reset) - any input needing to drop a negative prefix still returns wrong result
Hardcoded equality checks for two vectors mask failure and will fail hidden tests/production data
Deletes docstring/contract and adds brittle special-casing without general fix
